summary: Candidate template for a single-location, three-view asset sheet. The sheet has a header with title, type, status, version, and source/QA fields, one large HERO/ESTABLISHING view, two smaller support views (DETAIL/WORK SURFACE and APPROACH/REVERSE VIEW), and a GUIDANCE/CONTINUITY NOTES footer.

composition: Landscape template with dark green border and cream/white field.
Top header reads 'ASSET SHEET' with metadata columns: TITLE, TYPE, STATUS, VERSION, SOURCE/QA.
Metadata values: TITLE 'Single Location 3 View', TYPE 'Environment / location sheet', STATUS 'candidate', VERSION 'v1', SOURCE/QA 'GPT-authored template'.
One large HERO_ESTABLISHING panel labelled 'HERO / ESTABLISHING VIEW'.
Right column has two stacked panels: 'DETAIL / WORK SURFACE' and 'APPROACH / REVERSE VIEW'.
Bottom 'GUIDANCE / CONTINUITY NOTES' block describes intended use and restrictions.
guidance_notes: Use for one reusable environment or location needing a strong establishing view plus two support references.
Good for stakeholder dugout, judging table area, a single room, or a reusable staging zone.
Do not use for multi-location sets or character trios.

positive_constraints: Use this template for single-location environment/location asset sheets.
Keep the header metadata and three-view layout when populating the template.
Reserve the hero panel for the establishing view and the two support panels for detail/work surface and approach/reverse views.
negative_constraints: Do not use this three-view template for multi-location sets or character trios.
Do not treat 'candidate' status as final accepted canon.
Do not add extra views beyond the three prescribed.

best_for: QA of asset sheets built from this template.
not_sufficient_for: Final canon approval without sheet content and image QA.
Exact measurements; inspect the image pixels.
